title: Black Swan Real Estate standalone no-CRM outcome record

outcome_id.description: Immutable ID for this genuine business outcome; keep stable across export retries.

lead_id.description: Original intake BSRE lead ID; link to the protected intake register.

canonical_lead_id.description: Canonical intake record after manual person/role deduplication.

person_key.description: Private opaque person reference; never send to GA4 or derive from exposed contact data.

person_dedup_confirmed.description: Staff confirmed unique person/canonical mapping; required true for a qualified target count.

role.description: One of the five actual enquiry roles.

stage.description: Genuine confirmed business stage; no stage inferred from a click or form answer.

occurred_at_utc.description: Actual stage occurrence with explicit UTC Z suffix.

occurred_at_dubai.description: Same instant displayed with +04:00; do not independently invent or round it.

recorded_at_utc.description: When the operator recorded this ledger entry; distinct from occurrence time.

recorded_by.description: Authorized staff reviewer reference; no fabricated roster.

assigned_to.description: Current responsible consultant reference; handovers do not create new prospects.

qualification_status.description: Staff-reviewed status; raw acceptance and form answers never set QUALIFIED.

qualification_reason.description: Concise business reason; avoid unnecessary sensitive/free-text personal data.

contact_confirmed.description: Actual staff contactability confirmation, not merely valid phone syntax.

budget_inventory_fit_confirmed.description: Verified suitable budget/service/inventory fit where applicable; null if not applicable/pending.

timeline_confirmed.description: Role-specific actual timeline verified by staff.

authority_confirmed.description: Owner/representative authority verified for seller/landlord; null if not applicable.

duplicate_of_lead_id.description: Canonical original when this enquiry is a duplicate; retain history.

is_test.description: Authorized labelled test rows must be true and never exported/counted as qualified.

privacy_evidence_reference.description: Private reference to actual consent/CMP/notice/permission evidence relevant to processing/export.

ad_user_data.description: Actual permission state for the chosen import; do not infer from newsletter/contact permission.

ad_personalization.description: Separate actual personalization state; validate requirements for chosen use.

click_id_type.description: Only an actually captured identifier supported by the verified current import route.

click_id.description: Restricted legitimately captured attribution value; never fabricate, log publicly or send to GA4.

conversion_action_id.description: Verified Real Estate Google Ads action ID; blank until account readback.

conversion_name.description: Exact verified conversion name for the chosen import method.

order_id.description: Opaque stable ID based on outcome_id; distinct per genuine stage/occurrence.

conversion_value.description: Actual/evidence-based configurable value; no invented permanent value.

conversion_currency.description: ISO currency of the verified conversion value/action; AED only when actually applicable.

value_basis.description: Actual commission/contribution or documented expected-value model/version; separate property sale price.

export_state.description: Review/import lifecycle; planned exports do not equal confirmed imports.

exported_at_utc.description: Actual export time; blank before export.

import_job_id.description: Observed Google Ads import job/receipt reference; blank before a real job.

import_result.description: Observed row/job result; never default to success.

import_error_code.description: Safe actual error code without credentials or raw personal payload.

adjusts_outcome_id.description: Existing outcome being corrected/retracted with the supported platform adjustment process.

source_evidence_reference.description: Private source record proving the outcome/occurrence; not a bearer URL.

staff_notes.description: Restricted minimal operational notes; never put this field in analytics/export by default.

x-csv_null_convention: Blank optional CSV cell means null; explicit booleans are true/false. No sample records supplied.

x-stage_guardrails.qualified_prospect: Non-test, person_dedup_confirmed true, staff contact/timing/fit evidence and owner authority where applicable; first-ever qualification per person counts once.
x-stage_guardrails.commission_received: Actual received commission evidence/time/value; not property sale price or expected commission.
x-stage_guardrails.export: Verify customer/action/identifier support/current permission/window, exclude tests/duplicates and keep stable outcome/order IDs; no upload is performed here.

x-platform-limit: Local schema validation does not establish consent sufficiency, identifier eligibility, import format compatibility, attribution windows, live action mappings or actual business evidence; verify them separately.
